basic_details.job_title: IGIMS Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 109 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sheikhpura, Patna (IGIMS), Bihar, has invited applications for 109 posts of Junior Resident (Non-Academic) under Advt No. 03/Jr. Resident (N/A)/IGIMS/Estt./2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of Director, IGIMS, Patna, payable at Patna (non-refundable).

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS including completion of Internship or equivalent degree recognized by NMC; must have appeared in NEET-PG 2026 but not got admission to any Medical College
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS including completion of Internship or equivalent degree recognized by NMC; Appeared in NEET-PG 2026 but did not get admission to any Medical College in accordance to rules & regulations of Govt. of Bihar Experience: Work experience in Armed Forces, Central/State Health Services and Private Nursing Homes will be taken as equivalent to Junior Residency (Non-Academic); maximum one term allowed | Other conditions: | Only Indian Citizens may apply Benefit of reservation only for Bihar State domicile candidates Posts are non-practicing; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is strictly prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided Employed candidates must submit No Objection Certificate from employer; others a written statement that they are neither employed nor doing any course

salary_details.pay_scale: Level 10 of pay matrix, entry pay Rs. 56,100 per month + NPA and other admissible allowances

how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.igims.org.
Fill the form completely in the prescribed format.
Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates/testimonials and a recent passport size photograph.
Enclose the Demand Draft fee in favour of Director, IGIMS, Patna, payable at Patna.
Send by registered post, speed post or courier to the Director, IGIMS, Sheikhpura, Patna-14 (Bihar) to reach by 30-11-2026 till 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: Number of vacancies in each department may increase or decrease No TA/DA for attending counselling or joining Canvassing in any form is a disqualification If eligible EWS candidate is unavailable, Un-reserved candidate for respective department may be considered Updates, corrigendum or modification only on Institute website; no separate information Mere selection does not give the right to appointment

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 30 November 2026 Vacancies: 109 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: UR/EWS/BC/WBC: Rs. 1000; EBC/SC/ST: Rs. 250 Pay: Level 10 of pay matrix, entry pay Rs. 56,100 per month + NPA and other admissible allowances Place: IGIMS & Medical College, Patna

MBBS including completion of Internship or equivalent degree recognized by NMC; must have appeared in NEET-PG 2026 but not got admission to any Medical College

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 03/Jr. Resident (N/A)/IGIMS/Estt./2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IGIMS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS including completion of Internship or equivalent degree recognized by NMC; Appeared in NEET-PG 2026 but did not get admission to any Medical College in accordance to rules & regulations of Govt. of Bihar Experience: Work experience in Armed Forces, Central/State Health Services and Private Nursing Homes will be taken as equivalent to Junior Residency (Non-Academic); maximum one term allowed Other conditions: Only Indian Citizens may apply Benefit of reservation only for Bihar State domicile candidates Posts are non-practicing; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is strictly prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided Employed candidates must submit No Objection Certificate from employer; others a written statement that they are neither employed nor doing any course

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who got admission to a Medical College through NEET-PG 2026 Candidates who have already done one term (any joining and leaving counts as one term)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: One year tenure post Assessment at end of first 6 months; unsatisfactory performance leads to termination Quitting mid-way requires one month's prior notice or deposit of one month's salary Selection Committee's panel valid for 12 months only

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of Director, IGIMS, Patna, payable at Patna (non-refundable).

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application (till 4:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will IGIMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection / appointment according to NEET-PG Score 2026 Department allotment on the basis of availability of vacancy, merit-cum-choice and requirement in the Institute Departments allotted by vacancy, merit-cum-choice and Institute requirement

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Demand Draft of application fee Date of Birth Certificate (10th Certificate), 10+2/12th certificate All MBBS Mark-sheets, Degree Certificate, Internship Completion Certificate NEET-PG Score Card 2026 Caste certificate (EWS/SC/ST), Non Creamy Layer Certificate for BC/EBC, PWD Certificate, Freedom Fighters Certificate BMC/NMC registration certificate; NOC or non-employment declaration; NMC declaration for 2026-27

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.igims.org. Fill the form completely in the prescribed format. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates/testimonials and a recent passport size photograph. Enclose the Demand Draft fee in favour of Director, IGIMS, Patna, payable at Patna. Send by registered post, speed post or courier to the Director, IGIMS, Sheikhpura, Patna-14 (Bihar) to reach by 30-11-2026 till 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of vacancies in each department may increase or decrease No TA/DA for attending counselling or joining Canvassing in any form is a disqualification If eligible EWS candidate is unavailable, Un-reserved candidate for respective department may be considered Updates, corrigendum or modification only on Institute website; no separate information Mere selection does not give the right to appointment

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 109 vacancies for Junior Resident (Non-Academic).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Website www.igims.org) and send it to The Director, IGIMS, Sheikhpura, Patna-14 (Bihar), by registered post, speed post or courier, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/BC/WBC: Rs. 1000. EBC/SC/ST: Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 10 of pay matrix, entry pay Rs. 56,100 per month + NPA and other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS including completion of Internship or equivalent degree recognized by NMC; must have appeared in NEET-PG 2026 but not got admission to any Medical College.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Citizens may apply. Benefit of reservation only for Bihar State domicile candidates. Posts are non-practicing; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is strictly prohibited. Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who got admission to a Medical College through NEET-PG 2026. Candidates who have already done one term (any joining and leaving counts as one term).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection / appointment according to NEET-PG Score 2026. Department allotment on the basis of availability of vacancy, merit-cum-choice and requirement in the Institute. Departments allotted by vacancy, merit-cum-choice and Institute requirement.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: One year tenure post. Assessment at end of first 6 months; unsatisfactory performance leads to termination. Quitting mid-way requires one month's prior notice or deposit of one month's salary.
